items.title: Picsart開放創意AI平台，統一接入生成與編輯模型
items.summary: Picsart推出Picsart Platform，讓開發者把圖像、影片、音訊及文字生成接入自己的工具。
highlights: 同一套整合可使用不同供應商模型，以及Picsart的Enhance和背景移除工具。
平台提供API、Python及TypeScript開發套件、命令列工具和MCP連接。
items.why: 把生成與修圖放在同一接入層，創意技術團隊可評估能否減少每次換模型時重做串接的工作。
items.next_step: 選一條商品圖製作流程，檢查能否在同一整合內完成生成、去背及輸出，再比較換模型後需要修改的設定。
items.detail: Picsart表示，開發者可在統一平台切換模型，並在生成前後使用其自有編輯工具。MCP是讓AI助理連接外部工具的協定，命令列則適合把操作加入既有自動化流程。團隊可以先固定輸入圖片及輸出規格，核對不同模型回傳的檔案與編輯結果，再決定是否替換現有的個別串接。
items.title_en: Picsart opens a platform connecting creative generation and editing
items.summary_en: Picsart launched Picsart Platform for developers to add image, video, audio and text generation to their own tools.
highlights_en: One integration accesses multiple providers and Picsart's Enhance and background-removal models.
Access includes APIs, Python and TypeScript SDKs, a CLI and MCP.
items.why_en: Creative technology teams can assess whether one access layer reduces integration work when switching models.
items.next_step_en: Test product-image generation, cutout and export through one integration, then compare the settings needed after a model switch.
items.detail_en: Picsart says developers can switch models and use its editing tools before or after generation. MCP connects AI assistants with tools, while a CLI fits scripted workflows. Fix input and output specifications when comparing results and deciding whether to replace separate integrations.

items.title: Microsoft開放AI素材標示控制，可批次管理聲明
items.summary: Microsoft Advertising宣布AI內容透明度控制正式可用，讓廣告主申報圖像及影片中的AI生成內容。
highlights: 支援的格式可選擇可見浮水印，實際控制按廣告格式及工作流程而異。
素材聲明可經Ads Studio素材庫、API及商品資料源更新。
items.why: 素材披露加入批次管理，廣告營運團隊可把生成來源與上架欄位連結，決定哪些資產需要更新聲明。
items.next_step: 先抽查一批AI圖像及影片，把製作來源、素材聲明和實際版位的浮水印呈現逐項對照。
items.detail: Microsoft表示，平台的AI偵測訊號可作參考，廣告主仍需自行決定及負責內容聲明。控制涵蓋多種廣告格式，浮水印大小和位置亦可能隨版位改變。團隊可以把同一素材在素材庫、商品資料源及廣告預覽中的狀態並列，確認批次更新沒有遺漏版本或錯置生成來源。
items.title_en: Microsoft opens AI creative disclosures with bulk declaration controls
items.summary_en: Microsoft Advertising says AI content transparency controls are generally available for declaring generated images and video.
highlights_en: Visible watermarks are offered where supported, with controls varying by format and workflow.
Declarations can be updated through Ads Studio Library, APIs and product feeds.
items.why_en: Ad operations can connect production provenance with asset fields to decide which declarations need updating.
items.next_step_en: Compare provenance, declarations and rendered watermarks for a sample of AI images and videos.
items.detail_en: Microsoft says detection signals are a reference and advertisers remain responsible for declarations. Watermark size and placement vary. Compare each asset's library, feed and ad-preview states to catch missing versions or incorrect source flags during bulk updates.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google Cloud在合作夥伴行銷平台加入Gemini代理工具
items.summary: Google Cloud公布Partner Marketing Studio更新，把Gemini工具加入合作夥伴的聯合行銷流程。
highlights: 功能包括對話搜尋、品牌審閱、ISV素材生成、社群編輯及客戶案例草擬。
公告亦列出130種語言的輔助翻譯，以及自然語言分析。
items.why: 合作行銷團隊可把Google Cloud聯名規範放進素材製作階段，評估哪些渠道和語言版本可沿用同一工作流程。
items.next_step: 以一項Google Cloud合作方案建立聯名素材，逐項核對品牌審閱建議及各社群渠道改寫內容。
items.detail: Google Cloud的公告把這些能力定位於合作夥伴工作流程。品牌審閱代理協助檢查Google Cloud合作品牌指引，社群編輯則可調整渠道訊息並加入帳戶標籤。團隊可以先用一組已批准的聯名素材作參考，檢查代理的修訂是否仍準確呈現雙方角色及方案內容，再處理多語言版本。
items.title_en: Google Cloud adds Gemini agents to partner marketing workflows
items.summary_en: Google Cloud announced Gemini tools within Partner Marketing Studio for joint marketing by its partners.
highlights_en: Features cover conversational search, brand review, ISV assets, social editing and customer-story drafting.
The announcement also lists assisted translation across 130 languages and natural-language analytics.
items.why_en: Partner marketers can assess joint-brand rules during production and which channels and languages fit one workflow.
items.next_step_en: Build assets for one Google Cloud partner offering and reconcile brand-review suggestions with channel-specific copy.
items.detail_en: Google positions the tools for partner workflows. Its reviewer assists with partner brand guidelines, and the social editor adapts messages and account tags. Use approved joint assets as a reference to check both parties' roles and the offering before preparing translations.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Profound接入Teams，把AI搜尋分析帶進團隊對話
items.summary: Profound推出Teams及Microsoft 365整合，讓團隊在對話中查詢品牌的AI搜尋能見度、準確度及引用份額。
highlights: 在Teams提及Profound，可提出問題、建立代理或啟動Profound Project。
Teams版本現供有有效Profound訂閱的客戶使用。
items.why: AI搜尋問題可直接在協作對話中轉成分析工作，團隊可決定哪些能見度異常值得建立專案跟進。
items.next_step: 挑選一項引用份額變動，在Teams追問原因並建立專案，再比對回傳內容與Profound的原始資料。
items.detail: Profound表示，Microsoft 365整合可從SharePoint及OneDrive讀取文件，並建立或編輯Word和Excel檔案。系統亦可把選定內容帶入知識庫。行銷團隊可以從一個明確的AI搜尋問題開始，保留對話、來源與後續專案的連結，檢查資訊是否足以支持下一項內容調整。
items.title_en: Profound brings AI search analysis into Teams conversations
items.summary_en: Profound launched Teams and Microsoft 365 integrations for questions about AI search visibility, accuracy and citation share.
highlights_en: Mentioning Profound in Teams can start questions, agents or a Profound Project.
The Teams integration is available to customers with an active Profound subscription.
items.why_en: Teams can turn a visibility anomaly discussed in chat into a defined analysis project.
items.next_step_en: Investigate one citation-share change in Teams, start a project and compare its answers with Profound's underlying data.
items.detail_en: Profound says Microsoft 365 connections can read SharePoint and OneDrive files and create or edit Word and Excel documents. Selected content can enter a knowledge base. Keep the conversation, source and project linked when assessing a proposed content change.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Ideogram 4.6加入精確編輯API，可用遮罩限定修改範圍
items.summary: Ideogram推出4.6模型，提供Generate及Precise Edit API，用於生成及連續修改圖片。
highlights: Precise Edit可加入遮罩指定修改位置，並保留來源圖片尺寸。
模型支援最高4K輸出，Very low品質模式上限為2K。
items.why: 商品圖需要局部改背景或顏色時，團隊可評估遮罩編輯能否保留包裝文字和其他未指定區域。
items.next_step: 固定一張商品圖及一塊背景遮罩，比較不同品質設定的文字、邊緣和檔案尺寸，再決定哪種設定可進入素材流程。
items.detail: Ideogram列出Very low、Low、Medium及High四種API品質設定，生成與編輯的計費亦按設定及尺寸而異。使用者可把上次編輯結果作為下一次輸入。團隊可以逐次保存原圖、遮罩和輸出，比較連續修改後哪些商品細節改變，再決定是否把這條流程接入既有批次製作。
items.title_en: Ideogram 4.6 adds precise-edit APIs with optional masks
items.summary_en: Ideogram released 4.6 with Generate and Precise Edit APIs for generation and successive edits.
highlights_en: Precise Edit can use a mask to limit edits and preserves source dimensions.
Output reaches 4K, while Very low quality is limited to 2K.
items.why_en: Product-image teams can assess whether masked edits preserve packaging text and unselected areas.
items.next_step_en: Use one product image and background mask to compare text, edges and dimensions across quality settings.
items.detail_en: The API lists four quality levels, with pricing depending on settings, size and operation. An edit can become the next input. Keep source, mask and output versions to assess detail changes before connecting the workflow to batch production.

items.title: Google推出Gemini 4 Neon，以長上下文處理跨格式工作
items.summary: Google推出Gemini 4 Neon，提供100萬token上下文，可把多種檔案放在同一工作脈絡中處理。
highlights: 輸入包括試算表、PDF、圖表、音訊及影片。
模型在Gemini API等服務推出，Gemini應用程式的開放方案為Pro及Ultra。
items.why: 跨格式活動簡報可減少分開整理文件的工序，團隊可評估長上下文是否有助把素材與成效資料連結成同一份交付。
items.next_step: 以同一活動的PDF及成效試算表作固定輸入，要求輸出附來源位置的摘要，檢查跨檔案引用是否準確。
items.detail: Google把Neon定位為處理長時間、多步驟工作流程的模型，並提供四個思考層級供選擇。上下文token是模型可接收內容的容量單位，實際能放入多少檔案仍視內容而定。團隊可以先以一份有標準答案的活動資料測試，再決定適合把哪些跨格式工作交給模型處理。
items.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon for long-context, mixed-format work
items.summary_en: Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon with a one-million-token context window for work spanning multiple file types.
highlights_en: Inputs include spreadsheets, PDFs, charts, audio and video.
Rollout includes the Gemini API, with Pro and Ultra access in the Gemini app.
items.why_en: Campaign teams can assess whether one long context connects assets and performance data into a single deliverable.
items.next_step_en: Use one campaign PDF and spreadsheet to request a source-located summary and check cross-file references.
items.detail_en: Google positions Neon for long, multi-step workflows with four thinking levels. Tokens measure context capacity, so file coverage depends on content. Test a campaign dataset with known answers before assigning mixed-format work.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Phancy公布Phai-M1影音模型，模型權重仍待開放
items.summary: Phancy公布Phai-A1語言模型及Phai-M1影片生成模型，後者以真人風格影片為重點。
highlights: Phai-M1可在同一流程生成畫面及同步音訊。
公司計劃稍後開放兩款模型的權重，並提供網頁入口供用戶試用。
items.why: 真人風格短片團隊可把影音同步列入模型評估，並按網頁試用和未來權重開放兩種方式安排測試。
items.next_step: 先用同一段人物對白及動作要求記錄網頁輸出，再追蹤權重發布及部署條件，決定是否值得另建製作流程。
items.detail: Phancy表示，Phai-M1針對面部表情、身體動作及真人風格影像訓練，Phai-A1則處理長文及多步驟任務。公司把這些模型接入ModelHub XC等產品及PhanthyMovie應用。製作團隊可分開檢視網頁服務現時能完成的工作，以及權重開放後才可評估的部署選項。
items.title_en: Phancy announces Phai-M1 audiovisual model with weights still planned
items.summary_en: Phancy announced Phai-A1 and Phai-M1, with the video model focused on live-action-style content.
highlights_en: Phai-M1 generates visuals and synchronized audio in one workflow.
Weights remain planned for later release, while a web entry point is offered for trying the models.
items.why_en: Short-form teams can assess synchronization through the web service and treat future weight access as a separate deployment choice.
items.next_step_en: Record outputs for one fixed dialogue and movement brief, then track weight-release and deployment conditions.
items.detail_en: Phancy describes training around expressions, body movement and live-action imagery. A1 handles long text and multi-step work. The models connect to products including ModelHub XC and PhanthyMovie. Evaluate current web tasks separately from deployment options that depend on a later release.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: YouCam Muse推出歌曲與音樂影片製作，支援逐場修改分鏡
items.summary: Perfect Corp.推出YouCam Muse，讓創作者把歌曲構思或音軌轉成音樂影片，現供網頁及iOS使用。
highlights: 使用者可先審閱AI分鏡，再調整場景或重新生成鏡頭。
平台提供唱歌、敘事及混合視覺模式，並支援1080p輸出。
items.why: 音樂導向的短片企劃可先在分鏡階段比較歌曲與畫面配合，決定哪些段落需要重新構圖或演繹。
items.next_step: 用同一段歌曲副歌建立兩種視覺模式，先比較場景與歌詞的配合，再只重生需要修改的鏡頭。
items.detail: 公告表示，YouCam Muse可從自己的歌詞生成歌曲，也可使用上載音軌。網頁及iOS共用帳戶和點數，影片生成使用Seedance 2.5。團隊可以把AI分鏡作為前期討論材料，逐場記錄需要調整的角色、畫面及節奏，再比較修改後是否更貼近歌曲要表達的內容。
items.title_en: YouCam Muse adds songs and music videos with editable storyboards
items.summary_en: Perfect Corp. launched YouCam Muse on web and iOS to turn song ideas or audio tracks into music videos.
highlights_en: Users can review an AI storyboard, adjust scenes and regenerate individual shots.
Singing, storytelling and hybrid visual modes support 1080p export.
items.why_en: Music-led creative teams can compare how lyrics and scenes work together before deciding which shots need revision.
items.next_step_en: Use one chorus in two visual modes and regenerate only the shots that miss its meaning.
items.detail_en: The release describes lyric-to-song generation and uploaded tracks, with shared accounts and credits across web and iOS. Videos use Seedance 2.5. Treat the storyboard as pre-production material and record character, scene and timing revisions against the song's intended message.

items.title: 更進新聞：Genie 4開放開發者API，支援即時控制互動場景
items.summary: Google公布Genie 4可經Gemini API的Interactions API及Google AI Studio接入，讓開發者建立互動世界原型。
highlights: 輸入可用文字、參考圖或兩者，生成720p、24fps畫面及同步音訊。
鍵盤與即時文字提示可控制環境，生成內容含SynthID浮水印。
items.why: 開發者入口讓互動概念由網頁探索走向自建原型，品牌體驗團隊可決定哪些控制需要接到自己的介面。
items.next_step: 先畫出一條使用者控制路徑，列出鍵盤操作與文字指令要改變的場景元素，再估算原型所需的接入及生成成本。
items.detail: Google把開發者接入用於互動體驗、空間設計等原型探索，並提供AI Studio的互動畫布及起步範例。團隊可以先把一個展示概念拆成移動、觀察及改變物件的操作，判斷模型提供的即時控制是否足夠，再按文件中的定價及限制規劃開發。這項公布是開發者接入更新。
items.title_en: Update: Genie 4 opens developer APIs for interactive scene control
items.summary_en: Google announced Genie 4 access through the Gemini Interactions API and AI Studio for interactive-world prototypes.
highlights_en: Text, a reference image or both can generate 720p worlds at 24fps with synchronized audio.
Keyboard controls and live text prompts steer scenes. Outputs carry SynthID watermarks.
items.why_en: Developer access lets experience teams assess which controls to connect to a custom prototype interface.
items.next_step_en: Map one user-control path and its scene changes before estimating integration and generation costs.
items.detail_en: Google provides an interactive canvas and starter apps for prototype exploration. Break a concept into movement, observation and object changes, then judge whether live controls fit. Review documented pricing and limits before development. This is the developer-access update.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.followup: 11月20日版報道Ultra訂戶入口。這份API公告發布於11月19日，早於該期，補充開發者接入方式。
items.followup_en: Our November 20 issue covered Ultra subscriber access. This API announcement was published on November 19, before that issue, and adds the developer-access route.

items.title: Pika預覽Enact，以拖曳角色及鏡頭控制引導影片生成
items.summary: Pika公布Enact研究預覽，展示在影音生成過程中持續修改場景的實驗性介面。
highlights: 示範包括用滑鼠移動角色或物件、用語音指導表演，以及控制鏡頭。
Enact尚未向消費者開放使用，Pika提供研究及整合洽詢渠道。
items.why: 即時走位及鏡頭控制把生成提示變成持續導演操作，製作團隊可先盤點哪些廣告概念需要這類互動控制。
items.next_step: 列出一段涉及人物走位的鏡頭需求，記下需要控制的位置、表演及鏡頭路徑，作為研究試用開放後的評估條件。
items.detail: Pika表示，Enact建於H3 Flex，以短片段串流生成畫面和聲音，同時帶入新的導演指令。研究展示讓角色在影片播放中移動，並讓鏡頭按操作改變方向。團隊可把這些示範轉成具體的測試問題，例如物件移位後是否保持場景關係，再追蹤研究試用和整合機會。
items.title_en: Pika previews Enact for directing generation with actor and camera controls
items.summary_en: Pika unveiled Enact, an experimental interface for changing scenes during audiovisual generation.
highlights_en: Demos cover dragging actors or objects, spoken performance direction and camera control.
It remains unavailable to consumers, with research and integration inquiries offered by Pika.
items.why_en: Live staging turns prompts into ongoing direction. Production teams can identify concepts needing those controls.
items.next_step_en: Specify actor positions, performance notes and a camera path as evaluation criteria for any future research access.
items.detail_en: Pika says Enact streams short audiovisual chunks on H3 Flex while taking new direction. Demonstrations move subjects during playback and change camera direction. Turn them into test questions, such as whether moved objects retain their scene relationships, while tracking research access.
